description: Docs-checker sidecar — validates external API claims in a plan and records verdicts. Plan-side (pre-review pre-flight) home is the plan-derivable state/plan-sidecars/<plan-stem>.docs-check.md (moved out of docs/plans/ by docs/plans/2026-07-24-g2-plan-pipeline-sidecar-contract.md C11/D0). The code-review-side dispatch (no plan artifact to derive a stem from, D4) instead uses the session-keyed state/subagent-share/<session>/<provision_key>.md home, covered by the universal run-report superset schema, not this applies_to glob.

artifact.description: Repo-relative path to the plan/doc this sidecar checked.

checker.description: Agent identifier that ran the check (e.g. docs-checker).

claims_checked.description: Total number of API/factual claims evaluated.

verified.description: Claims confirmed correct by an authoritative source.

unverified.description: Claims that could not be confirmed (source unavailable, not enough evidence).

incorrect.description: Claims found to be wrong; auto-fixed or flagged for human correction.

auto_fixed.description: Claims that were silently corrected inline by the checker.

verification_source.description: Primary source used for verification (e.g. Context7, training-knowledge-aug2025).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the sidecar (e.g. reviewed, implemented). Not enumerated — legacy values vary.
